adminMenuDecisions.reason: Operational status and incident triage are required to verify real FE-BE-integrated jobs; only real timestamped server data
Job failure, partial, retry, quotas need details; no independent section until load warrants it
EDA/provenance quality report should be a filter or detail linked to a collection run
Data rights, policy block, deletion/retention evidence, actor/time/target audit are product integration gates
Actual billing and refunds explicitly outside M9; entitlement introspection can be in account support later

adminMenuDecisions.destination: External support tool / links if real incidents demand it
adminMenuDecisions.reason: No evidence of active support queue, SLA, customer support backend; do not build a duplicate support system
Access logs are a subset of audit events, not a separate top-level workflow

qaMenuDecisions.reason: Forced QUEUED/RUNNING/PARTIAL/FAILED and evidence unavailable states belong in automated fixtures, not in customer or production operation UI
Actual YouTube hover pointer races cannot be validated by a web admin page
403/BOLA/tenant isolation must be server enforced and independently tested, not by UI role toggle

qaMenuDecisions.destination: Node/Playwright test runner with reproducible SHA
qaMenuDecisions.reason: Test execution and PASS/FAIL evidence should come from runner results, not manually toggled dashboard

qaMenuDecisions.destination: Test artifact viewer/review index (if non-developers need it)
qaMenuDecisions.reason: Playwright HTML/trace and CI/local test artifacts already support reviews; a custom results database is not an M9 prerequisite

crossCuttingIssues.finding: 82 sidebar inventory differs between 82-01 (includes subscriptions/support) and 82-02 (includes access history) but only operations↔policy are linked
crossCuttingIssues.recommendation: Stable navigation with two main pages; move subsidiary modules into panels/filter or defer

crossCuttingIssues.finding: 4 duplicate Access Boundary Notice instances each followed by an identical separate Role access boundary frame at y=877..958 in a clipped 900px screen
crossCuttingIssues.recommendation: Keep one reusable Notice component; eliminate duplicate clipped frame in a separately approved design change

crossCuttingIssues.finding: Four prominent State CTA frames contain status text but have 0 Figma reactions
crossCuttingIssues.recommendation: Use neutral read-only status badge, or implement real actionable control only when backed by an audited server action

crossCuttingIssues.finding: All 12 metric cards show non-live placeholders; all 16 task rows are descriptive with zero interactions
crossCuttingIssues.recommendation: Display measured values with source/lastUpdated or one honest unavailable banner; transform task rows to real resources when available

crossCuttingIssues.finding: QA simulation controls are only descriptive and can be mistaken for a working QA console
crossCuttingIssues.recommendation: QA requires reproducible fixtures and negative tests; Figma prototypes/QA website not equivalent to executable tests

crossCuttingIssues.finding: Frontend routeDefinitions and AppRoutes only expose customer/demo YU-01..12 and no /admin or /qa routes; backend initial README
crossCuttingIssues.recommendation: Classify Figma 82/83 as proposals, do not say operational product exists

crossCuttingIssues.finding: 83-02 footer describes Chrome extension as initial skeleton only, while YU-26 Hover implementation is merged
crossCuttingIssues.recommendation: Refresh stale QA copy based on source state, or omit temporary implementation-status boilerplate

crossCuttingIssues.finding: Admin and QA role strings repeated in topbar/hero/sidebar
crossCuttingIssues.recommendation: One role/environment indicator in topbar, with permission detail on demand

productMilestoneBoundary.finalMilestone: M9 PRODUCT_INTEGRATED, not public release or payment launch
mustHaveActions: read actual system/analysis Job status and failures
read approved data policy and deletion/retention evidence
verify server-authoritative access and audit events
trace test result to exact commit/environment and logs
mayBeImplementedWithoutCustomWeb: metrics/logs dashboards through existing observability stack
productMilestoneBoundary.keepAdminSurface: 2 lean web views only: Operations and Policy & Audit; extra sections and actions by observed need
productMilestoneBoundary.deferQaSurface: No dedicated QA application required at M9 if local/CI test runner + immutable artifact index covers testers; optional internal read-only results viewer
productMilestoneBoundary.orgAdminSurface: 81-02 remains separate customer organization management; never a platform operations admin

suggestedAcceptanceGates: ADMIN-AC-01 Operations displays only server-measured job/health/quota data with source/time and unknown!=zero
ADMIN-AC-02 Policy gate refuses unapproved derived metrics and shows approval/version/retention/deletion evidence
ADMIN-AC-03 Every admin request enforces server session and role/tenant scope; secrets and raw comments redacted
ADMIN-AC-04 Any job retry is explicit, idempotent, restricted by role and audit-logged; no silent 'force success'
ADMIN-AC-05 82 sidebar destinations represent actual routes and stable navigation; no clickable-looking disabled dead ends
ADMIN-AC-06 One and only one permission notice per screen, no clipped duplicate or unbounded text
QA-AC-01 Tests produce PASS/FAIL with tested SHA, environment, command, raw evidence, and retry history
QA-AC-02 Synthetic states isolated from customer/production DB and role-toggle attack surfaces
QA-AC-03 Installed Chrome MV3 Hover/SidePanel and BE auth negative tests run separately from Figma
QA-AC-04 If an internal QA viewer is later built, it consumes test-run artifacts read-only; does not fabricate test results
